background.text: So you arrived in the House as part of the Tea Party movement in 2011. I did. Then you were elected to the Senate in 2014. background.text: What was that work like and what was your relationship with her like back then?

ground_truth: She was a brand new senator coming in in 2017. We actually traveled to Afghanistan together, and so we did have the opportunity to be able to spend some time. Obviously, that was challenging for us and for her. She's very progressive. I'm very conservative. When I talk to people in Oklahoma, they'll say, I couldn't work with the people that you work with.
